name: desktop-empty-project-notice
goal: Show the empty project explanation as readable normal text instead of a disabled empty field

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Self-review of the18 passing picker images found the disabled native No projects yet placeholder too faint at all viewports, even after removing duplicate dimming.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The previous empty guard checked DOM visibility while disabled native option painting remained faint. The same three empty cases now require normal empty-state text and no useless choice field.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Checkpointcf2b5b4965 fails all3 existing empty viewport cases. Record64b156d1570564f65ff0ba513f48b4d18646d03fbae4e39afaf51eeafb8c53d5 retains the faint disabled-field before images.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix af3ecbbbb9 renders normal No projects yet text and omits the empty choice field without changing the three viewport guards.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched red 64b156d157 and green 41a605d049 use the frozen cf2b5b4965 test corpus and identical command/profile. All three viewport cases pass; all six original before/after PNGs inspected.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
